sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hunting Trip is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come on in. Want some tea? Well, whatever. So listen, here's the deal. Soon I will be hosting a few friends of mine. I want to go hunting with them, but there's just no way I can take them hunting with these MP shotguns, right? I have a couple of nice western rifles here, but I need them to be zeroed properly first. And we have just the client for that, his name is Shturman. So, test my build (Remington M700 sniper rifle with a FullField TAC30 1-4x24 scope) on this scum. Find a long-range position and make a precise shot to the head, so that the bastard wouldn't even have a chance. Don't worry, I won't disappoint you with the reward, kid."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 33 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Locate and neutralize Shturman with a headshot from over 40 meters away while using an M700 sniper rifle with the specified scope

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +15,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.02
- 100,000 Roubles
  - 105,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 115,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× VPX Flash Storage Module
- 1× Iridium military thermal vision module
- 1× Phased array element
- Unlocks purchase of Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle at Jaeger LL4
"Those are damn great rifles! Good work! You know, I think I might get into gunsmithing myself, I took quite a liking to this thing. So, about the reward: check out the little things I found, you might need them."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill Shturman from over 40 meters away with a headshot while using a Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle with a Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope. To have the kill count for this quest, the Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope just needs to be installed on the gun, and not necessarily be actively used. This means you can use a ring mount that supports backup sights, like the Recknagel Era-Tac 30mm ring scope mount, and use any compact reflex sight of your choice on top.
